Game Overview

In Stacking Color, the core idea is straightforward: master high-rise construction in Stacking Colors. Align colored blocks perfectly to build towering structures. As intensity rises, your precision and reflexes are tested. Quick placement yields larger blocks, while misalignment spells the end. Can you adapt to the escalating pace and stack to the sky?
